reference: How long has she been tapping that keycard on the wrong door?
sk: Ako dlho prikladá tou kartou na nesprávne dvere?
cz: Jak dlouho přikládá tou kartou na nesprávné dveře?
acceptable: How long has she been tapping {that|the|this} {keycard|card|key card|access card} {on|against} the wrong door?
How long has she been holding {that|the|this} {keycard|card|key card|access card} {to|against|up to} the wrong door?
How long has she been pressing {that|the|this} {keycard|card|key card|access card} against the wrong door?

mistakes.text: How long does she tap {that|the} {keycard|card} on the wrong door?
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“, nie „does she tap“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“, ne „does she tap“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has she been tapping”, not “does she tap”.

mistakes.text: How long is she tapping {that|the} {keycard|card} on the wrong door?
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“, nie „is she tapping“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“, ne „is she tapping“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has she been tapping”, not “is she tapping”.

mistakes.text: How long she has been tapping {that|the} {keycard|card} on the wrong door?
mistakes.feedback_sk: V otázke je „has“ pred podmetom: „How long has she been…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V otázce stojí „has“ před podmětem: „How long has she been…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In a question, “has” goes before the subject: “How long has she been…”.

mistakes.text: How long has she tapped {that|the} {keycard|card} on the wrong door?
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dlhom deji, ktorý stále prebieha, je prirodzenejší Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U dlouhého děje, který pořád probíhá, je přirozenější Present Perfect Continuous: „has she been tapping“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a long action that is still going on, Present Perfect Continuous is more natural: “has she been tapping”.
